title: Calibrate legal page-deal orbits and freeze the two container-label form predictions
statement: The original raw-EVA query inventories reproduce: 886, 894 and 759 label words, and within-page exact shares .09594, .10179 and .07246 in ZL, IT and RF. Full within-section permutations give IT p=.012–.017, compared with nominal .002–.005 when all non-singleton pages are forced off their original slots. In the seven-page practice subset the full orbit has eight assignments and the forced-other support has one; exact full permutation p is .375/.500/.625/.500 in ZL/IT/RF/GC. The forced-other program returns .001 in ZL, IT and GC after 999 repeats of the same assignment. In the exchangeable null orbit, 37.5–50% of assignments have zero forced-other exceedances. With the same non-label inventory for each origin page and last normal P locus withheld, strict length and frequency matching leaves 32–37 equivalent tokens per arm on 9–10 leaves across witnesses. All four paired intervals include zero. Relaxing matches to the same section gives smaller label than ordinary-word recurrence excesses in all four. The two specified container contrasts have stable native directions in the public source corpus. Exact one-sided length p=.0725/.0959/.1642 and final l/r depletion p=.0368/.0415/.0491 in ZL/IT/RF. The shared practice sample is one folio with 3/11 eligible locators, and the attainable minimum one-sided final-l/r tail is .32967.
check: Use exchangeable page orbits for randomization significance. Keep practice experiments positionally comparable using the same paragraph exclusion for both matched arms and report coverage by section. For the separate form hypothesis freeze only two within-folio tests before any closed score: longer raw EVA Lc locators and depleted terminal l or r relative to Lf. Verify independent scan-to-object identifications for multi-locus labels, then calibrate conditional power and review a declarative selector that preserves locus subtype.

methods.legacy: Select pages from the public parsed source corpus with at least three certain label words of at least three units and thirty certain non-label tokens. Compare raw EVA with EVA-basic length eligibility and a one-unit edit sensitivity. Claston uses case-sensitive native raw symbols. Deal whole query bags among references in the same section. Singleton-section pages are fixed. Both deal policies use identical inventories and two fixed seeds.
methods.matched: Use the final available normal P0/P1 locus on each eligible six-normal-locus page. Remove it from the common non-label reference for both query arms. Match label and held-line word tokens within page on exact unit length and fine reference frequency with fractional minimum cell weights; source frequencies exclude the original numeric leaf. Resample numeric leaves conditional on the matched inventories. Report shared page/last-locus and exact count sensitivities. The relaxed section matching uses common references and allows different query masses per page.
methods.exact: Enumerate all eight assignments and every permitted relative derangement for the practice sections. Report how many null assignments have no equally good forced-other sample and would give an apparent .001 under that Monte Carlo comparison. Verify edited matching against a dynamic-programming Levenshtein check in 28,800 cases.
methods.jars: Use IVTFF unit L with subtype c and f in the pharmaceutical section, requiring both on the same folio and certainty throughout each locator. For each folio count assignments preserving the number of container marks exactly. The directions are longer summed raw character length and lower terminal l-or-r rate for c. Compare alternate EVA segmentations, uncertain-space policies and a cautious four-group adjacent-locus sensitivity. In the one common practice folio, verify exact support by enumerating individual subsets.

limits: The public exposed corpus and official practice-evaluation subset are distinct scopes. The work uses no committed evaluation membership. Query availability limits the paired comparison to biological and pharmaceutical sections. All witnesses read one manuscript and subtype is inherited markup rather than an independent visual classification. A locator can comprise part of a multi-line object label. The fixed-ending-stock practice calculation conditions on these observed margins.

frozen_design.legacy_recurrence: Rebuild unrestricted within-section label-bundle deals with 999 fixed-seed permutations. Separate declared raw-character and EVA-basic >=3 eligibility conventions. Nonlabel references contain all certain non-L units. Include section singleton pages as fixed if otherwise eligible. Report negative drawing-free control and derangement sensitivity.
frozen_design.paired_recurrence: Use own and other eligible pages in the same section. Require 3 label tokens of >=3 EVA-basic units, 6 normal paragraph lines of subtype 0 or 1 where the final line has eligible ordinary query tokens, and at least 30 certain tokens in the same nonlabel reference inventory after withholding that last line. All queries point to the same reference for each origin page.
frozen_design.match: Equalize token masses within origin page, exact EVA-basic length, and separately measured sectional document token frequency. Background excludes the query page and its numeric leaf siblings. Fine frequency bins consist of exact counts 0–8 and powers-of-2 thereafter, with exact all-count sensitivity. Matched cell weight is min of the two query counts plus fractional within-cell allocation. Keep matching fixed across permutations.
frozen_design.endpoints: Report label minus ordinary difference of own/cross excess and both ratios; ratios are missing if denominators zero. Shuffle bundles of both kinds by same within-section permutation. Report p for label own association, paired difference, and percentile numerical-leaf bootstrap of observed paired differences. Print all retained page/section/token counts.
frozen_design.jar_labels: Freeze only two one-sided jar-vs-fragment contrasts, raw EVA character length of full Lc locus greater than Lf and a lower rate of last l or r in Lc. Use finite exact tag reassignment preserving per-folio counts. Confirm both on each independent transcription before considering a closed claim. Analyze raw locator metadata without guessing hidden membership.
frozen_design.scope: Published parsed public witness transcription plus separate official public practice evaluation sensitivity. No committed evaluation membership, unpublished pages, or new source assumptions.

reproduction.setup: Use verified project raw text, Python standard library and the project root on PYTHONPATH. Extract the reproducible scripts using the named relative locations.

scripts.exact_deals.py:
"""Check the ordinary randomization rank and the forced-other diagnostic."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from itertools import permutations, product
import json
from math import factorial, prod
from pathlib import Path

from vs import ivtff, split
from recurrence import EDITIONS, groups, legacy, words_matrix, fast_exact, glyphs, edits1

def complete(bins, force_other=False):
    choices=[]
    for group in bins:
        options=list(permutations(group))
        if force_other and len(group)>1:
            options=[x for x in options if all(a!=b for a,b in zip(x,group))]
        choices.append(options)
    count=sum(map(len,bins))
    for one in product(*choices):
        result=list(range(count))
        for group, row in zip(bins,one):
            for source,target in zip(group,row):
                result[source]=target
        yield result

def test(pages):
    bins=groups(pages)
    refs=[set(p.reference) for p in pages]
    mat=words_matrix([Counter(p.labels) for p in pages],refs,fast_exact(refs))
    count=prod(factorial(len(g)) for g in bins)
    assert count<=10000
    orbit=list(complete(bins))
    forced=list(complete(bins,True))
    assert len(orbit)==count and forced
    def score(order):
        return sum(r[j] for r,j in zip(mat,order))
    realized=score(list(range(len(pages))))
    totals=[score(x) for x in orbit]
    result=dict(bins=[len(g) for g in bins],orbit=len(orbit),forced_support=len(forced),realized_hits=realized,
                orbit_score_counts=dict(Counter(totals)),exact_p=sum(v>=realized for v in totals)/len(totals))
    histogram=defaultdict(int)
    for center,observed in zip(orbit,totals):
        right=sum(score([center[j] for j in o])>=observed for o in forced)
        histogram[right]+=1
    result.update(forced_true_tail_histogram_by_numerator=dict(histogram),forced_never_exceeds=histogram[0],
                  forced_never_exceeds_fraction=histogram[0]/len(orbit),
                  realized_forced_tail=sum(score(x)>=realized for x in forced)/len(forced))
    return result

def edit_oracle(a,b):
    prev=list(range(len(b)+1))
    for i,x in enumerate(a,1):
        row=[i]
        for j,y in enumerate(b,1):
            row.append(min(prev[j-1]+(x!=y),row[j-1]+1,prev[j]+1))
        prev=row
    return prev[-1]<=1

def verify_near():
    chars=('a','ch','o')
    items=[''.join(s) for n in range(1,5) for s in product(chars,repeat=n)]
    tested=0
    for bracket in ('raw','eva-basic'):
        refs=[{word} for word in items]
        test_hit=edits1(refs,bracket)
        for i,word in enumerate(items):
            for query in items:
                assert test_hit(i,query)==edit_oracle(glyphs(word,bracket),glyphs(query,bracket))
                tested+=1
    return tested

def main():
    cli=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    cli.add_argument('raw',type=Path)
    arg=cli.parse_args()
    witnesses={n:ivtff.parse(arg.raw/f) for n,f in EDITIONS.items()}
    practice=set(split.select('practice',witnesses['zl']))
    out={n:test(legacy([p for p in pgs if p.id in practice],'raw')) for n,pgs in witnesses.items()}
    print(json.dumps(dict(edit_metric_checks=verify_near(),practice=out),indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
scripts.independent-jar/jar_limit.py:
"""Check the attainable one-sided ending tail on the common practice labels."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
from itertools import combinations
import json
from pathlib import Path

from audit import FILES, KINDS, groups, measure, selected_sum_counts
from vs import ivtff, split

def main():
    cli=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    cli.add_argument('raw',type=Path)
    args=cli.parse_args()
    editions={k:ivtff.parse(args.raw/v) for k,v in FILES.items()}
    ev=set(split.select('practice',editions['zl']))
    label_ids=set.intersection(*(
        {l.id for p in ps if p.id in ev and p.section=='P' for l in p.lines
         if l.unit=='L' and l.subtype in KINDS and l.words
         and not any(ivtff.uncertain(w) for w in l.words)}
        for ps in editions.values()))
    checks=0
    out={}
    for view,ps in editions.items():
        pairs=groups([p for p in ps if p.id in ev],label_ids,'certain')
        assert len(pairs)==1
        folio,lines=next(iter(pairs.items()))
        n=sum(l.subtype=='c' for l in lines)
        values=[measure(l,'ending_lr') for l in lines]
        endings=selected_sum_counts(values,n)
        raw=[measure(l,'eva-raw') for l in lines]
        length=selected_sum_counts(raw,n)
        for subjects,table in ((values,endings),(raw,length)):
            literal=Counter(sum(c) for c in combinations(subjects,n))
            assert literal==table
            checks+=literal.total()
        out[view]=dict(folio=folio,jar=n,fragment=len(lines)-n,ending_hits=sum(values),
                       jar_ending_hits=sum(measure(l,'ending_lr') for l in lines if l.subtype=='c'),
                       total_assignments=endings.total(),min_ending_lower_tail=endings[min(endings)]/endings.total(),
                       min_length_upper_tail=length[max(length)]/length.total(),ending_table=endings)
    print(json.dumps(dict(assignments_cross_checked=checks,views=out),indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
